# Run the analysis

After successful checks:

```bash
python scripts/python/run_workflow.py --data-dir data/my-study --output-dir results/my-study
```

Use `--config path/to/your-config.json` for documented parameter changes. Separate output folders when comparing configurations. Read `run-record.json`, then inspect the figures and full QC table before writing results.

Rendering the guide does not run this command. Your figures are not automatically inserted into lessons; add image links only after verifying them.
